shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade/launch world integration, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat; Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL (useHitPoints false, Flammability 0); removal = Remove gizmo (deconstruct icon) or architect deconstruct. VERIFIED round 13.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend gizmos, two-hop rides).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses far side). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops. Giddy-Up mounted riders blocked.
- Stairs do NOT unroof anything below. Sky-side landing platforms (footprint+1) are RoofSurface, exempt from air-reversion while stairs stand.
- T9 VERTICAL UTILITY LINKS (Building_ABUtilityLink, ext utilityOnly): counterpart lifecycle, never pawns, no climate exchange. AB_VerticalConduitUp/Down (Power, Electricity, CompABPowerBridge); AB_VerticalWaterPipeUp/Down (DBH patch-gated). ABPipeCompat routes per-def flags; VEF nets stairs-bridged only.

## Sky surface model (round-10 final)
- Owned terrains: AB_OpenAir, AB_RoofSurface, AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule with 8-neighbor re-sync; wall-only changes converge on the 2000t sweep.
- Mountain cap: vanilla fog material clones, overlap-free 3x3 tiling, two runtime queues; mined floors fill in source rock edge color.
- Sync self-heal: subscription retry (250t) + ReconcileRooftops; natural roofs generation-time only.

## See-below renderer (round-13 water model, VERIFIED)
- Static pass: lower map's section meshes via pure cloned materials at forced queues under the measured terrain queue.
- WATER: Watergen excluded (subcamera-only depth pass); DrawBelowStatic pushes lower.waterInfo.SetTextures() every frame so terrain-layer water renders with the REAL vanilla water shader (flow texture + map size globals re-pointed; safe, sky map has no water; last setter wins at render time).
- MASK: fog-of-war opacity + constant baseDim slider only; no light-based darkening (round 12).
- Dynamic pass: ONE-WAY MIRROR. Ceiling hints; far clip 70. Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch + demand pull + export pinning + carried-cargo delivery. Column-aware stuff picker.
- Needs: rest/food across column. Medical rescue three ways (auto giver, emergency migration, forced float menu - verified). Capture via float menu. CarriedIntent through StairTransfer.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels; colonist bar per column; level buttons; camera preserved; beds alert aggregated.
- Power/pipes/climate bridges per link; ABPendingOrders replay (also caravan joins).

## T8 threats + pocket-level NPC movement (round-13 VERIFIED)
- Divert already-fired surface incidents; pacing/points vanilla. Toggles default OFF + chance slider.
- POCKET INCIDENT REDIRECT (round 14): prefix on IncidentWorker.TryExecute re-targets ANY incident aimed at one of our pocket levels (dev palette current-map vector, stray mod calls) to the column surface - no trader ships over the basement, no cargo pods on open air. Our diverts retarget after this chokepoint so opt-ins still route back down. DeepDrillInfestation exempt (drill-local by nature). Foreign pocket maps untouched (no column ground).
- Infestations -> basement (VERIFIED): CanFireNowSub postfix + relaxed finder (TryFindBasementInfestationCell: 220 samples, standable+unfogged+thick roof+>=6 from colonist buildings, prefers farthest) + infestationLocOverride seeding (lenient SpawnTunnels, cannot fizzle); vanilla finder preferred when it accepts.
- Drop raids -> sky (VERIFIED): prefix on TryResolveRaidSpawnCenter of the four drop workers; skips quest raids/preset centers/sieges/non-hostiles; validates drop room.
- POCKET NPC SCAN (VERIFIED incl. raid animals + visitor exit): all non-player pawns, 250t, loop-is-the-gate. Hostiles: humanlike/mech/faction animals; insects/manhunters/entities never; idle (incl. bashing immortal links) + no reachable target -> stairs down, lord released, assault lord joined on arrival. Friendlies/neutrals: exit-intent duties (TravelOrLeave, TravelOrWait, Kidnap, Steal, TakeWoundedGuest, PrisonerEscape) or lordless idle -> stairs down, LordJob_ExitMapBest on ground arrival; mid-visit duties never touched.

## T11 world integration
- Settings: columnWealth (ON), worldIntegration (ON). Guard: world.
- TILE IDENTITY: WorldObject.Tile postfix (Valid-check first) gives our PocketMapParents the ground tile.
- COLUMN WEALTH: ground-map storyteller getters aggregate linked levels; skipped in fixedWealthMode.
- CARAVANS: column free colonists listed; off-surface picks trimmed + stairs ride + pending-join; all-off-surface rejected.
- TRADE: beacon listings column-wide; debt drains level by level; pocket consoles hail surface ships; purchases drop at surface.
- SETTLEMENT LOSS: vanilla semantics + column-colonist confirmation; pocket maps die with ground natively (destroyOnParentMapAbandoned explicit).

## Performance architecture
- ABGuard plain-bool switches; AnySkyLevels gate; NearestUsableStairsCached memo. Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t, pocket NPC scan 250t. Zero recurring cost with no levels. TryExecute redirect prefix: two null checks + comp lookup per incident execution (rare path).

## Compat
- DBH + VEF bridges; Reverse Commands; Fluffy Animal Tab; Declutter UI; Giddy-Up; incompatibleWith MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1; RimThreaded unsupported; foreign pocket maps read as level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/cap cells on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim; tall below-sprites clip at rooftop edges; wall-only edits converge on sweep; mined-floor hard tint edges; bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples as singles in beds alert; RC direct links only; restaurants per-level; stuff picker direct links only; doctor pile-on window.
- Below-view water: vanilla shader, no depth shading (shores read slightly flat).
- T8: mounted Giddy-Up raiders never descend; basement insects do not resurface. Incidents can never target pocket levels directly (by design, round 14).
- T9: VEF nets bridge at stairs only; vertical links can open a level like stairs.
- T11: caravan items surface-only; animals/prisoners not listed cross-level; purchases drop at surface; transporter loading surface-only; Odyssey gravship interactions unsupported/untested.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE + verified. T8/T9 verified rounds 12-13 (immortal links, descend AI incl. animals, visitor exit assist, basement infestation, vanilla water from above, dark-below fix). Round 14: pocket incident redirect - pending verification (low risk).
- Next: T5 publishing prep. Backlog: VEF per-net shafts, caravan items/animals cross-level.

## Status
Rounds 12-13 verified in-game. Round-14 pocket incident redirect implemented and compiling. T5 publishing prep is next.
